name: MyFundedFutures
legal_entity_and_hq: MyFunded Futures, LLC (Texas governing law; disputes venue Collin County, Texas, USA). Street address not published in the Terms.
instruments: CME Group futures: CME (equity index E-mini/micro, FX, Micro Bitcoin/Ether, livestock), CBOT (grains, Dow), NYMEX (energy), COMEX (metals). SI, HG, PL, NG, QG temporarily restricted as of 2026-10-16.

programs.name: Builder
programs.notes: Max drawdown is $1,500 or $2,000 depending on the option chosen.

programs.name: Rapid
programs.drawdown_type: EOD in evaluation; intraday trailing on the sim funded account

news_trading: Restricted: positions and orders must be flat from 2 minutes before to 2 minutes after Tier 1 releases (FOMC, FOMC minutes, NFP, CPI; EIA for energy, ag reports for ags) on Rapid and Pro sim-funded accounts; allowed in all evaluations and on Builder
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: automated strategies allowed if tailored to the trader's own settings and not exploiting sim fills; HFT not allowed; live automated trading must follow CME guidelines
copy_trading: Allowed on all account types for the trader's own accounts (Tradesyncer preferred, Tradovate group copier OK); copying other traders or sharing devices is prohibited
overnight_weekend_holding: Not allowed: open positions are auto-closed at 4:10 PM ET on regular trading days (on holiday early closes there is no auto-liquidation and the trader must flatten).
restricted_countries_note: 90 restricted countries/regions incl. China, Russia, Ukraine, Turkey, UAE, Serbia, Croatia, Romania, Bulgaria, Nigeria, Pakistan, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia. List: https://help.myfundedfutures.com/en/articles/8229993-restricted-countries-policy
path_to_live: Live accounts start at $0 balance with EOD drawdown. Rapid: automatic after $10,000 net profit in a single day or Risk team approval. Pro: review after 3 consecutive payouts, reaching the $100K payout cap, or invitation. Builder: after the 5th approved sim payout. Up to $5,000 of sim profits held in a Reserve that covers a live breach or is paid as a performance bonus.

affiliate_program.commission: commission on evaluation and reset fees from referrals; rate not published; monthly payout, $100 minimum
affiliate_program.notes: Apply via the MFFU dashboard. Paid advertising (PPC, native ads), paid endorsements and spam are prohibited; affiliate must live in a non-restricted country.
